notes: Five taḥwīl branches end at their own last name; «كل هؤلاء عن سمى، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة» is written once after the last «ح» and applies to every branch (rule 3)
«جميعا عن سفيان» is attached to the last branch (the one it follows); the Sufyan link is written there only
«بمثل حديث مالك» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
«عبيد الله» in the third branch is the name written as «عبيد الله» after «حدثنا»; the dashes and «وهو ابن» style glosses are not present in this report
